operational.decision_match_flag_limit: flag requires both books to exist; two absent snapshots also return false. Compare recorded monotonic timestamps separately before inferring stale evaluation.
operational.processing_measurement_limit: receipt follows application read before parsing; recorder precedes book application; exact apply timings also in engine market_processing; pre-read network/socket buffering remains unobserved

production_metrics.measurement_limit: source age includes clock bounds; not network or fill latency

final_snapshot_history_audit.reason: complete audit verified; idle periodic deadline 120s

operational.no_order_verification: closed session, order OFF and no attempts/pending orders asserted in every usable local-status sample; final fresh exchange account read is documented separately

local_context_at_lag_events.limit: Cumulative recorder maxima and concurrent REST do not prove a callback's cause.

limits: Frame counters include startup; window event counters exclude startup.
Hook time covers measured recorder operations, not a comparative CPU benchmark.
Library dequeue is not kernel arrival; app frames are observed after read.
Timer lag and REST concurrency are correlation, not host/network/upstream causation.
Coverage timestamps are existing status observations, not invented exact transitions.
